key_insight: The paper argues that superconducting quantum chip design is reaching a "SPICE moment," requiring a model-driven quantum chip paradigm rather than experience-based engineering.
engineering_relevance: It reframes Q-EDA as a full chip-development stack that connects physical device design, simulation, fabrication, and measurement feedback for scalable quantum processors.
method: Build PCell-based models for Josephson junctions, resonators, couplers, readout, and packaging.
Use SPICE-Q simulation with Quantum PDKs to co-design devices and layouts.
Close the loop with design-technology-measurement co-optimization across hierarchy levels.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual framework and hierarchical system proposal, but does not report experimental results or quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: A major implementation challenge is integrating accurate physical models, fabrication variability, and cryogenic measurement feedback into reusable design objects.
